name: Xero
description: Read supplier bills (accounts payable) and contacts from the authenticated user's Xero organisation.
_authNote: OAuth endpoints, scopes, client secret ref, offline_access and the tenant_id capture are PLATFORM-OWNED — they live in the private clarity-api (integrations-v2/config/oauth-configs.ts + integration-http-specs.ts), never in this public repo. This manifest only declares that the integration uses oauth2 and which tools it provides.

providedTools.description: List supplier bills (AP invoices, Type=ACCPAY) for the connected org.
List supplier contacts for the connected org.
Fetch a single supplier bill by id.
List supplier (AP) credit notes — the confirmation a vendor actually credited back an overbilling.

_localNote: Studio CANNOT broker this yet: no connector in packages/connectors. Calling any of these tools from an automation will fail at run time. See .claude/skills/add-an-integration/SKILL.md to request one.
